# Account Owners: Create a Taxbit Account Owner

Area overview and notes: [account-owners.md](../account-owners.md)

`POST /account-owners` · tenant-scoped token

Create an Account Owner to link with accounts in Taxbit's system. By default, you can use this API at 50 requests per second (RPS). If your use case requires a higher RPS, please contact your Implementation Manager.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `account_owner_type` | string | Yes | The type of Account Owner. One of: `INDIVIDUAL`, `ENTITY`, `INTERMEDIARY`. |
| `name` | string | No | Account Owner's full name. |
| `email` | string | No | Account Owner's email address. |
| `phone` | string | No | Account Owner's phone number. |
| `birth_date` | string (date) | No | ISO-8601 date when the Account Owner was born. |
| `valid_self_certification_on_file` | boolean | No | Whether a valid self-certification is on file for the Account Owner. When a self-certification tax document is on file, this reflects the latest self-certification's validation status; otherwise it reflects the value you provided. |
| `tin` | string | No | Account Owner's TIN. **Deprecated.** |
| `tin_type` | string | No | The type of TIN. One of: `US_SSN`, `US_EIN`, `US_ATIN`, `US_ITIN`, `SSN`, `EIN`, `ATIN`, `ITIN`, `OTHER`. **Deprecated.** |
| `tax_country_code` | string | No | The two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country the Account Owner is subject to taxes in. **Deprecated.** |

Example request body:

```json
{"id":"JohnDoe864","name":"John Anthony Boush","email":"john.boush@email.com","phone":"(123) 456-7890","birth_date":"2020-08-19","tin":"123-45-6789","tax_country_code":"US","us_tin":"123-45-6789","address":{"first_line":"7203142 East 11th Avenue","second_line":"APT 11","city":"Woodlands","state_or_province":"TX","country":"US","postal_code":"77381"},"controlling_persons":[{"name":"Sarah Boush","role":"SENIOR_MANAGING_OFFICIAL","ownership_percentage":25.5,"date_of_birth":"1980-05-15","city_of_birth":"Berlin","country_of_birth":"DE"}],"prefers_physical_mail":false,"is_tax_exempt":false,"birth_city":"Seattle","birth_country":"US","vat_country_code":"DE","vat_id":"58694837384","business_registration_country_code":"DE","business_registration_number":"5968574","financial_account_id":"6968473","financial_account_holder_name":"John Anthony Boush","giin":"123456.99999.SL.528"}
```

**Response 201**: Account Owner Successfully Created.

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID for this object. This is a version 4 UUID. |
| `data.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Tenant ID for your organization. |
| `data.date_created` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date when the account owner was created in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.date_modified` | string | Yes |  |
| `data.account.taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID for this object. This is a version 4 UUID. |
| `data.account.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Tenant ID for your organization. |
| `data.account.date_created` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date when the account was created in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.account.date_modified` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date when the account was last modified in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.account.account_owner_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 403 Forbidden · 409 Conflict · 429 Too Many Requests
